description: A human-signed USF-100 directive that treats the signature as implementation authority by itself must fail closed.

mutation.directiveText:
# Directive

## Human-Only Acceptance Boundary

Human-only acceptance boundary.

USF-39 remains Backlog.

A separate USF-39 start action and a final pre-extraction revalidation are required.

Implementation is authorised by this signature alone.

## Acceptance Signature Block

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorising human (name) | Example Human |
| Authorisation date | 28 June 2026 |
| USF-100 acceptance recorded | recorded on the USF-100 Linear issue |
| Separate USF-39 start action authorised | not authorised by this signature |
